A [[human]] worked as a '''newscaster''' during the [[Imperial Era]].<ref name="Announcement" /> In [[5 BBY]],<ref name="Date">"[[Announcement]]" take place shortly after "[[Kassa (episode)|Kassa]]," which dates itself to [[5 BBY]].</ref> this individual reported on the events of the [[Aldhani heist]]. In the reporting, observed by [[Syril Karn]] and his [[Eedy Karn|mother]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]], several details were disclosed to the public such as multiple [[Death|fatalities]], the presence of a [[blockade]], and an ongoing investigation into the [[Aldhani rebel infiltration team|perpetrators]] of the incident.<ref name="Announcement" />

==Behind the scenes==
The character first appeared in "[[Announcement]]", the seventh episode of the live action television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', where they were portrayed by [[Richard Lister]].<ref name="Announcement" />
